subject: literacy
concept: Using context clues to figure out the meaning of an unfamiliar word
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading vocabulary sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student acts out an unfamiliar word's meaning based on clues given in a short spoken sentence
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an unfamiliar word in a sentence to the correct picture, using surrounding context
exercise.abstract: Student infers the meaning of an unfamiliar word from a written sentence's context

misconception_flags: guesses meaning from word shape/sound rather than context

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
